keepOriginal.name: Keep original file
keepOriginal.helpText: Store the original files you upload to the service, this way no data will be lost. This will also store exif data.

hostOverride.name: Host Override
hostOverride.helpText: Override the hostname for the server, useful for when you are accessing the server from a different domain.

removeDerivativesAfter.name: Cached Images Expiry Time
removeDerivativesAfter.helpText: Time before cached converted images are deleted. This does not affect the original image. A lower cache time will save on disk space but cost more cpu. Set to 0 to disable.

allowEditing.name: Allow images to be edited
allowEditing.helpText: Allow images to be edited (e.g. resize, flip). Using these features will use more CPU power.

conversionTimeLimit.name: Convert/Edit Time Limit
conversionTimeLimit.helpText: Time limit for converting/editing images. You may need to increase this on low powered devices.

conversionMemoryLimit.name: Convert/Edit Memory Limit MB
conversionMemoryLimit.helpText: Memory limit for converting/editing images. You only need to increase this if you are storing massive images.

jwtSecret.name: JWT Secret
jwtSecret.helpText: Secret used to sign JWT authentication tokens.

jwtExpiresIn.name: JWT Expiry Time
jwtExpiresIn.helpText: Time before JWT authentication tokens expire.

bcryptStrength.name: BCrypt Strength
bcryptStrength.helpText: Strength of BCrypt hashing algorithm, 10 is recommended. Reduce this if running on a low powered device.

enableTracking.name: Enable Ackee Web Tracking
enableTracking.helpText: Enable tracking of the website usage using Ackee. You will need to set the tracking URL and ID.

trackingUrl.name: Ackee tracking URL
trackingUrl.helpText: URL of the Ackee tracking server. Requests are proxied, so ensure the X-Forwarded-For header is handled.

trackingId.name: Ackee trackign website ID
trackingId.helpText: ID of the website to track.

enableTelemetry.name: Enable System Telemetry
enableTelemetry.helpText: Enable system telemetry, this will send anonymous usage data to the developers.
